$Comment: An example layout plan on the Stone kit CommonLib ships (DungeonRooms/Kits/Stone): a room to arrive in, two or three fights with a corridor or none between each, and a large room to end in, every door left open closed by a Stone wall cap.

The dungeon Zc_Example_Stone runs it. Copy this file under your own pack's id to start a plan of your own: Rooms.Tags picks the kit, Path the beats in order, Links the connectors, Bounds the box a layout must fit in.
